name: Ranch Hand Trail Stop Homestyle Biscuits & Country Sausage Gravy
whyItWorks: Soft buttermilk biscuits have zero insoluble roughage, but the rich pork sausage milk gravy and black pepper make this a heavy dish best reserved for full remission or ordered as plain biscuits with honey.
prepOrOrderInstructions: During flares or sensitive days, order a plain buttermilk biscuit with honey/jelly and scrambled eggs instead of the sausage milk gravy.
watchOuts: Country gravy is high in rendered pork fat, whole milk lactose, and coarse black pepper
